company_overview: Postman is an AI-native API platform designed to help engineers develop, test, manage, and distribute APIs and services. It delivers high productivity for developers, API quality, and governance at enterprise scale, serving 500,000 companies including 98% of the Fortune 500.
target_audience: Developers, engineering teams, and enterprises of all sizes. The platform specifically targets organizations across various industries, including financial services (e.g., PayPal, Nubank), technology companies (e.g., Cisco), and AI agent builders seeking to secure and manage API traffic.

company_overview: Supabase is an open-source backend platform that provides a fully managed Postgres database along with integrated features such as authentication, storage, real-time data, and edge functions. It allows developers to build and scale applications quickly by combining these essential services into a single, production-ready infrastructure.
target_audience: The company targets developers, startups, enterprises, innovation teams, agencies, hackathon contestants, and product teams. It serves users who need to build and scale applications, including both technical engineers and non-technical teams looking to create production software with AI tools, across industries such as FinServ, Healthcare, and B2B SaaS.

company_overview: Vapi is a unified platform that allows developers and businesses to build, deploy, and improve voice AI agents with sub-500ms latency, enterprise-grade configurability, and real-time monitoring.
